evaluation_criteria.evaluation_scope: Common reference criteria applied to every primary trace for campaign mission_success; original reports retain their own configuration-specific criteria. Other evaluation metrics copy research_metrics.

limitations: SYNTHETIC simplified engineering reference; not flight-qualified. Paired noise-seed experiments conditional on the selected plant configurations and fault schedules; not independent missions or a calibrated hardware reliability distribution. Student-t 95% mean intervals assume iid seed outcomes and approximate normality; n=1 has no mean interval. Zero-width intervals mean no observed seed variation, not certainty; no multiple-comparison correction. Wilson 95% intervals describe the binary research mission-success proxy, not flight reliability. Common reference criteria evaluate mission_success for every primary trace using the reference temperature limits and fixed battery, communications and unserved-energy requirements. Variant controller thresholds still affect the simulated plant, but cannot relax this campaign evaluation criterion. Original reports retain their own configuration-specific research metrics for replay; campaign summaries and deltas use evaluation_metrics. Paired variant deltas are variant minus reference for the same strategy and seed. Strategy deltas use the same variant and seed, relative to basic when selected, otherwise the first selected strategy. Missing metric values are omitted only from that metric; paired deltas require both values. Detection latency conditions on detected episodes. Recovery outcomes are immediate command effects, not lasting repairs. Closed-loop histories can differ; the same seeds pair exogenous noise draws, not identical telemetry. Assured protected baselines are retained for replay and checked, but never counted again as independent trials. No general AI superiority claim, hardware command path or external model service.
